scope: Prometheus v3.16.0 evaluates synthetic telemetry: a utilization gauge served by a local test endpoint. An 80-to-0 synthetic metric transition exercises a 10-second low-utilization alert. The lab runner scales exactly the case-owned saf-0703-008-idle-target Deployment from one replica to zero only after it observes a firing alert with the expected case_id and synthetic gpu_id labels. A separate synthetic protected Deployment must remain ready. No DCGM exporter, NVIDIA driver, GPU resource request, device plugin, hardware utilization, real GPU allocation, production workload, or production reclamation is involved.

checks.claim: Observed active utilization keeps the rule clear and the fixture running
The low utilization sample remains pending while the target is still running
The specific synthetic idle rule fires after its required hold
The exact synthetic target reaches zero with the protected workload still ready
